name: Toggle switch
looksLike: pill that slides left and right to turn something on or off
little round knob on a track
definition: A two-state control that turns a setting on or off immediately, like a physical light switch.

prompts.short: Add an on/off toggle switch with a label. Apply the change instantly.
prompts.detailed: Add an accessible toggle switch (switch role, aria-checked) with a visible label, a sliding knob, and the on state in the accent color. It applies immediately, so don't add a Save button. Support Space to toggle and a visible focus ring.

reactTailwind: <span className={`block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white transition ${on ? "translate-x-5" : ""}`} />
vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Use the switch role with aria-checked
Don't rely on color alone to show the state
